name: Abuelita Elena's Shrimp Diabla (Night 1)
whyItWorks: Sautéed shrimp in a fiery roasted chili-tomato Diabla sauce with lime—capsaicin and citrus make this a direct flare trigger.
prepOrOrderInstructions: If you want shrimp at Plaza de Coco, ask your server for plain grilled or poached shrimp with butter/garlic and zero Diabla sauce or lime.
